claim_verdicts.evidence: Round 2: lesson now carries the condition. Tool Detection (release-3.1): "If a specific tool is explicitly configured, then that tool is selected"; "If not, then the tool is detected implicitly"; "Kustomize if there's a kustomization.yaml, kustomization.yml, or Kustomization"; "Otherwise it is assumed to be a plain directory application." Sections 3, 4, 6 and q1 now say "when an Application names no tool".

Round 1 at stage-3: apps/staging.yaml path envs/staging, automated {selfHeal: true, prune: true}, no tool block. Round 2: the Application files under deploy/gitops/config-repo/apps/ (staging, edge-staging, policies-staging, traefik) contain no `path: envs/production` (grep over deploy/). Checked in the submodule working tree; git show at the tag needed approval this session.

Round 3: lesson now says "writes each kustomization.yaml ... leaving out files the config repository does not hold yet, then pushes the commit back". Matches gitops.sh: config_repo=.gitops/donhang-config (local copy); config_take writes from the layout and drops `  - <file>.yaml` lines whose file the clone lacks; config_commit does git add -A, commit, push. Script lines 26-37 unchanged.

Round 3 wording "instead of waiting for its next periodic check of the repository": Webhook page (release-3.1): "Argo CD polls Git repositories every three minutes to detect changes to the manifests." Carried: merge patch removes the automated policy (Auto sync docs); app_refresh annotates argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=normal ("Indicates that app needs to be refreshed."); config_head --verify prints the full id.

Carried from round 1 (unchanged): captured real run at stage-3 lists "ConfigMap api / ConfigMap api-... / Deployment api" before syncing, then "the api's ConfigMap: api-..." and "new ReplicaSets of the api: 1".

Carried from round 1: auto_sync docs: automated sync "will not delete resources when Argo CD detects the resource is no longer defined in Git" unless prune is true (apps/staging.yaml sets it). deployment.md:167: rollout "is triggered if and only if the Deployment's Pod template (that is, `.spec.template`) is changed". Lesson now says "lets Argo CD delete objects the commit no longer contains": same behaviour.
Script lines 56-60: "# Automated sync on again, as apps/staging.yaml has it." kubectl apply -f "$config_repo/apps/staging.yaml"; app_wait_sync; app_wait Synced Healthy.

envs/production/kustomization.yaml lines 17-39: comment on promoting as one change (tag and digest deploy-verified.sh verified for staging); images entries with newTag + digest; line 24 digest sha256:4f05067078ab...ea83d for donhang-api.

Carried from round 1: Kustomize glossary: overlays "create different variants of a common base"; "the overlay's kustomization points to the base." kustomize-render.txt: both overlays render 41 objects from the same base, diff only replicas 2 vs 3.

Code block verified character for character in round 1 (unchanged). New prose on the `if:`: GitHub expressions docs, hashFiles: "If the `path` pattern does not match any files, this returns an empty string." so the step runs only when some envs/*/kustomization.yaml exists. The ci.yml comment says SealedSecrets "exist only in the config repository": no CI on its commits.

Carried from round 1: kubeconform README: -strict "disallow additional properties not in schema or duplicated keys"; -kubernetes-version "version of Kubernetes to validate against". v0.8.0 cmd/kubeconform/main.go: `cfg.Files[0] == "-"` sets useStdin.

Carried from round 1: Tool Detection selects the tool per application ("to create your application's manifests"); apps/traefik.yaml has source.chart traefik 41.6.1, apps/staging.yaml has source.path envs/staging.

Opinion with a condition ("may package it as a chart"); the factual tail now reads "the chart's values file is where it lists the settings it expects people to change", consistent with Helm best practices: "Every defined property in `values.yaml` should be documented." Traefik as an Ingress controller matches the module outline (k8s.l2.ingress: "an Ingress controller, here Traefik's Pods").

Carried from round 2. Lesson softened "ending in" to "contains" the digest. `kubectl kustomize` still could not be run (permission not granted this session). Kustomize images page does not document the printed form when newTag and digest are both set. base/api.yaml:33 is the only donhang-api reference, so "one line" holds; the digest in it is neither documented nor run.

Kustomize patches page: "Patches (also called overlays) add or override fields on resources." and for allowKindChange/allowNameChange: "By default, these fields are false and the patch will leave the kind and name of the resource untouched." Lesson section 6 and q4 now say "patch fields of any object the base builds".

issues.text: Carried from round 2. Wording now "contains" the digest (weaker), but claim 14 is still unverified: no captured run of the command, and the Kustomize images page does not document output when newTag and digest are both set.
issues.quote: the first run prints one line, the api's image, and it contains `sha256:4f05…83d`, the digest on line 24
issues.fix: Run `kubectl kustomize deploy/gitops/config-repo-kustomize/envs/production | grep 'image: .*/donhang-api[:@]'` at stage-3, capture it with tools/capture-output and cite the output in claim 14's source_hint; if the digest is not in the line, rewrite the expected result to match.
